370c2e98da3749cb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة واجز للمقاولات عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في عنيزة، القصيم. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات ومضخات التدفئة ومكيفات الهواء. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة بشكل عام، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف لضمان دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة واجز للمقاولات في عنيزة، القصيم. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة في جميع الأوقات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

37d7f444b418d2b8.description: About Canonical Canonical is a global software company known for publishing Ubuntu and providing open-source enterprise solutions for cloud, developer, IoT, and AI. Ubuntu is recognized as a leading Linux distribution and holds the position of the number one OS in the cloud. Canonical collaborates with major technology companies such as Google, Amazon, IBM, and Microsoft to assist businesses in enhancing agility, productivity, and adopting new technologies. Customer applications include AI, Blockchain, IoT, Advanced Robotics, and self-driving cars, where Ubuntu serves as a preferred development platform. The Role of Sales Development Representative (Arabic Speaker) Canonical is seeking a Sales Development Representative to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is considered part of a technology sales academy, focusing on identifying customer projects that align with Canonical's product lines and expanding the company's presence across various industries and geographies. The ideal candidate will be organized, persistent, charismatic, and hard-working, with an interest in technology and its business implications. This position requires 0-1 years of experience. Demonstrated passion for business and technology. Commitment to continuous learning and improvement, characterized by curiosity, flexibility, and a scientific approach. Ability to engage in creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Results-driven mindset with an over-achiever spirit. Persistence and perseverance in achieving objectives. Compensation and Benefits Base pay for this role will be determined by factors including geographical location, experience level, knowledge, and skills. In addition to competitive base pay, Canonical provides team members with additional benefits that align with company values. Certain roles may also be eligible for annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilization. Further details on benefits specific to the work location can be discussed with a Talent Partner. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a workplace free from discrimination, valuing diversity of experience, perspectives, and background.

373af189bb75afaf.description: We are looking for a Planning Specialist to own the manpower capacity plan for dark store operations within our Planning & Fulfilment department. You will translate forecasted demand and store requirements into shift-level manpower plans that maximize utilization and minimize Cost Per Order (CPO), ensuring the right headcount is available for each shift. You will also monitor planning accuracy, investigate the root causes of deviations, and track daily staffing shortages across stores. This role sits within the Manpower Planning team and reports to the Planning Manager. You will work with Operations Fulfilment, Store Management, Operations Performance, and Ground Operations. The role is office-based, with regular visits to dark stores across the network. Responsibilities Build manpower capacity plans by store, city, day, and shift. Convert order forecasts into headcount requirements using productivity standards and workload assumptions, and update plans when demand or store conditions change. Create shift schedules that maximize manpower utilization and minimize CPO. Account for labor regulations, contract hours, rest periods, staff availability, skills, third-party logistics (3PL) allocations, and store capacity. Follow up with the Operations Fulfilment team to confirm that shifts are uploaded and the planned headcount is deployed. Resolve gaps and escalate blockers to the Planning Manager. Compare forecasted and actual demand, as well as planned and actual staffing, by store and shift. Identify root causes, implement corrective actions, and report planning accuracy KPIs to the Planning Manager. Monitor daily staffing shortages by store. Flag their impact and recovery options to the Fulfilment team and Store Management, and publish the daily shortage report. Maintain planning models, trackers, and dashboards. Prepare weekly planning reports and recommendations for the Planning Manager. 2+ years of experience in workforce planning, operations planning, or capacity planning in quick commerce, retail, or logistics. Experience converting demand forecasts into staffing requirements and shift plans. Experience with shift scheduling and labor optimization under multiple constraints. Strong analytical skills and experience with root cause analysis. Advanced Excel skills. Understanding of CPO drivers and labor cost structures. Ability to coordinate with fulfilment and store teams to implement staffing plans. Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Statistics, Business Administration, or a related field.

37494e13b6421c06.description: About Mace Group Mace Group combines construction expertise with consultancy services to enhance projects and redefine ambition. The company's values guide its approach and define the professionals it seeks to join its team. Role Overview: Senior Construction Manager (Night Shifts) Mace Group is seeking experienced Senior Construction Managers to join the delivery team for a major, high-profile stadium project in Riyadh. This role is a hands-on site delivery position supporting night-shift operations, with an initial focus on civil, structural, and superstructure works. The night-shift arrangement is expected to operate for a minimum of approximately 18 months, with six nights worked per week during each six-week rotation. This project is part of a large mixed-use development in Saudi Arabia, including sports facilities, entertainment, arts, and associated infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Lead and oversee construction activities during the night shift. Maintain a strong, visible presence on site throughout the shift. Monitor civil, structural, and superstructure works to ensure appropriate progress. Coordinate with contractors and the wider project delivery team. Maintain accurate shift diaries, construction logs, and records of site activities. Identify and escalate construction, programme, or interface issues requiring resolution. Ensure health, safety, and site standards are maintained throughout night operations. Provide clear handovers and communication to the wider project team. Proactively challenge unsafe practices or poor site performance. Support effective coordination between construction packages and stakeholders. Qualifications and Experience A degree or equivalent qualification in construction management, civil engineering, or a related built-environment discipline is preferred. Relevant professional membership or chartership is advantageous. Significant construction management experience on major, complex projects (5-10 years required). Strong civil, structural, and/or superstructure construction experience. Ideally from a main contractor background, either currently in contracting or having transitioned to PMC/client-side project delivery. Strong site leadership and practical construction knowledge. Comfortable working independently and making sound decisions during night operations. Ability to challenge contractors appropriately and maintain high standards. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Experience working within Saudi Arabia or the wider Middle East is advantageous. Stadium experience is beneficial but not essential. Work Environment This is a part-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, focused on night-shift operations. The role requires a highly visible presence across the site to ensure safe and effective delivery of works. Mace Group is an inclusive employer and welcomes applications from a diverse range of candidates, including those interested in part-time, flexible, and hybrid working options where suitable for the role. Application Information Even if you do not fulfill all the criteria, you are encouraged to apply, as you may still be a suitable candidate for this role or another within the organisation.

37f28c446507adaa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة البابطين للطاقه والاتصالات عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية اليومية، بما في ذلك إعداد المستندات المحاسبية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وتسجيل القيود، وتدقيق الحسابات البنكية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في المجال المحاسبي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. متابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها بشكل دوري. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات المخصصة. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات. تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من اكتمال شروطها القانونية والمالية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في هذا المجال. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ المحاسبة وإعداد القيود المالية. مهارات في تدقيق الحسابات البنكية وإعداد التسويات. بيئة العمل يعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي في مقر الشركة بمدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بالمهام المحددة لضمان سير العمليات المالية بسلاسة وفعالية. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد المستندات والتقارير. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحليل الإيرادات والنفقات. القدرة على استخدام الأنظمة والبرامج المحاسبية. مهارات تنظيمية لإدارة وحفظ الوثائق المالية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتواصل الفعال. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى شركة رائدة في مجال الطاقة والاتصالات والمساهمة في دعم عملياتها المالية في الرياض. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة.

37ab803946431929.description: About the Role Eaton is seeking an Accountant to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Region. 37ef7da906c1d886.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصنع سبلة للخبز عن كاتب موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة تاروت. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم عمليات الموارد البشرية اليومية، مع التركيز على إدارة سجلات الموظفين والوثائق المتعلقة بالتوظيف. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية حفظ وتحديث سجلات الموظفين بشكل دقيق ومنظم. تسجيل البيانات الشخصية للموظفين الجدد والتأكد من اكتمال جميع الوثائق المطلوبة. معالجة طلبات التوظيف، الترقية، النقل، والإعارة، ومتابعة سيرها. جمع البيانات الإضافية اللازمة عند الحاجة لدعم عمليات الموارد البشرية. تسجيل الوقوعات المتعلقة بحالة الموظف وتحديث بياناته المسجلة بانتظام. حفظ المستندات المؤيدة للوقوعات وإخطار الجهات ذات الصلة بها. الحفاظ على سرية بيانات الموظفين والتعامل معها بحرص، مع التحقق من عدم تسريبها أو تداولها إلا مع الأطراف المعنية ووفقاً للتعليمات المحددة. إعداد التقارير المتعلقة بالتوظيف ورفعها إلى المختصين لغرض المراجعة واتخاذ القرار. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الموارد البشرية أو دور إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع البيانات الحساسة والحفاظ على سريتها. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية جيدة. بيئة العمل تتمثل بيئة العمل في مصنع سبلة للخبز بمدينة تاروت، المنطقة الشرقية، حيث سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق الموارد البشرية. كيفية التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل مصنع سبلة للخبز، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

3739d6211c3a70d0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بسموق للمقاولات عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان بيئة عمل آمنة ومتوافقة مع معايير السلامة، من خلال المراقبة الدورية وتطبيق الإجراءات الوقائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء جولات ميدانية منتظمة لمراقبة بيئة العمل والتأكد من الالتزام باشتراطات وقوانين السلامة. التحقق من ارتداء جميع العاملين لمعدات الوقاية الشخصية (مثل الخوذ، النظارات، الأحذية الواقية، حبال الأمان) بشكل صحيح. التأكد من جاهزية وكفاءة أدوات الإطفاء، طفايات الحريق، صناديق الإسعافات الأولية، وأنظمة الإنذار وكاشفات الدخان. الإبلاغ الفوري عن أي قصور أو خلل في أنظمة السلامة أو وجود مخاطر محتملة في الموقع. المشاركة في تسجيل الحوادث أو الإصابات التي تقع في مقر العمل وتحليل أسبابها لمنع تكرارها. دعم حملات التوعية وتوجيه العمال الميدانيين على السلوكيات والبروتوكولات الآمنة أثناء أداء مهامهم. المساعدة في تطبيق خطط الإخلاء وإدارة الأزمات وحالات الطوارئ عند حدوثها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على إجراء التفتيش الميداني والمتابعة الفعالة. معرفة جيدة باشتراطات وقوانين السلامة. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف الصحة والسلامة المهنية بدوام كامل في مواقع العمل التابعة لشركة بسموق للمقاولات في مدينة الرياض. يتطلب الدور التواجد الميداني المستمر لضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل المدينة: الرياض الراتب: غير معلن التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

37489ebb3a230ff6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سما صلاله للمقاولات عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة ومراقبة الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم الفني للمهندسين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية، والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها. تقديم المساعدة للمهندسين الكهربائيين في حل المشكلات الفنية. تحديد المخطط وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين المتعلقة بأعمال التركيب الكهربائي. اختبار الأنظمة بعد تركيبها لضمان التقيد بالمخطط الأولي والمواصفات المطلوبة. القيام بعمليات الفحص الروتينية ضمن أعمال الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة، وتشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم قوي لمبادئ التركيب والصيانة الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والمواصفات الفنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في نجران. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في مجال المقاولات، مع التركيز على تنفيذ المشاريع الكهربائية بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

37beabbeb03719b8.description: Delivering world-class infrastructure, buildings, and environmental solutions Be part of shaping our business and driving innovation initiatives About SJ Group Surbana Jurong Group is a leading global urban, infrastructure, and managed services consulting firm. 372efa93a25fd737.description: About Us Tamara is the leading shopping and payments platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region, with a mission to empower people in their daily lives and revolutionize how they shop, pay, and bank. The company was founded by serial entrepreneur Abdulmajeed Alsukhan along with his partners Turki Bin Zarah and Abdulmohsen Al Babtain. Tamara operates out of its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and has offices in the UAE, Egypt, Germany, and Vietnam. Our large, dedicated team of professionals continues to grow as we expand our reach and impact. Serving millions of users and partnering with thousands of merchants, Tamara collaborates with leading global and regional brands such as SHEIN, Jarir, noon, IKEA, H&M, and Farfetch, as well as local small and medium businesses. The company is backed by SNB Capital and Sanabil Investments, a wholly-owned company by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), Checkout.com, Coatue, Shorooq Partners, and Endeavor Catalyst, among others. Your role We are looking for a Senior Compliance Associate to support the Compliance Department in ensuring full adherence to SAMA regulations applicable to payment services, including activities under the Electronic Money Institution (EMI) license and other Payment Service Provider (PSP) categories. The role involves both advisory and monitoring responsibilities to ensure ongoing regulatory compliance. You are a driven, determined, curious team player, knowing that collective strength means we all win. With a positive outlook, you are solution-oriented–persevering regardless of circumstances, always finding a way through, no matter the challenges. You will effectively find a way to work with everyone through empathy and respect. You will be driven and comfortable with responding quickly with urgency, with the ability to change course without losing momentum and energy, resulting in great success. Your responsibilities Ensure compliance with all applicable SAMA regulations related to payment services (e.g., EMI, PSP, wallet providers). Review and approve new products to ensure alignment with SAMA requirements. Monitor internal processes and product structures for regulatory adherence. Track, interpret, and implement changes from SAMA circulars and regulatory updates. Review and maintain internal policies and procedures to ensure consistency with current SAMA regulations. Ensure receipt and proper dissemination of all circulars and publications issued by SAMA; follow up with relevant departments to ensure timely implementation. Prepare and submit accurate regulatory reports to SAMA within required timelines. Review management reports submitted to SAMA for accuracy and completeness. Coordinate with internal teams to collect and validate data required by SAMA. Support regulatory inspections, audits, and remediation actions as needed. Provide advisory support to internal stakeholders on payment-related compliance matters. Your expertise Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, Finance, or a related field. Minimum 1–2 years of experience in a compliance role at a SAMA-regulated entity operating in the payments sector. Solid understanding of SAMA’s regulatory framework for payment services. Experience in regulatory reporting and policy review. Fluent in English and Arabic (spoken and written). Strong communication, coordination, and analytical skills. Detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.Fluency in English and Arabic. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

37514710dfee9e40.description: About Efficio Efficio is a global specialist in procurement and supply chain consultancy, with a team of over 1,300 individuals representing more than 60 nationalities. The Saudi team, comprising nearly 250 professionals, supports clients across the Kingdom in achieving Vision 2030 objectives, particularly in managing cost portfolios, accelerating procurement value, and meeting Local Content and ICV requirements for large infrastructure and Giga projects. The Role: Management Consultant (Saudi Nationals Only) Efficio is seeking a Management Consultant to join its full-time operations in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role is open to Saudi Nationals with 0-1 years of experience. As a Management Consultant, you will report to a senior team member and be responsible for specific workstreams within client projects, contributing to the development and implementation of strategic solutions. Key Responsibilities Manage the collection and interpretation of client data to support solution development. Drive data analysis and identify key insights and issues. Oversee multiple small or complex categories. Support and guide junior consultants, ensuring adherence to Efficio methodologies. Manage relationships with client stakeholders to secure buy-in for strategies. Set strategic direction, solve complex client problems, and tailor solutions. Plan and implement strategies to achieve targeted outcomes. Develop and execute sourcing and negotiation strategies. Participate in the recruitment process for potential junior consultants. Required Qualifications and Skills Management consulting experience within a leading consultancy, ideally in procurement and/or supply chain, or equivalent industry experience. Experience or interest in strategic sourcing, procurement transformation, supply chain, operations, infrastructure, or capital projects. Proven track record of working closely with senior client stakeholders. Deep analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to isolate key issues and draw sound conclusions. Strong grasp of detail and a hands-on approach. Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills. Ability to confidently improve existing ways of working, recognize opportunities, and identify innovative solutions that add value to clients. Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint. Work Environment and Culture Efficio fosters a collaborative and inclusive culture, valuing diverse backgrounds, ideas, and viewpoints to develop innovative client solutions. The firm encourages proactive innovation and challenges the status quo through strong analytical thinking and creative problem-solving. Strong opportunities for career growth are provided, supporting ambition and a proactive approach to career development. Flexibility to travel to meet client needs is required, and preferences can be communicated during the application process. Application Candidates are encouraged to highlight any additional skills or experiences relevant to the role.

379f861f17aafb3a.description: About AstraZeneca AstraZeneca is a global biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of prescription medicines for serious diseases. The company is undergoing a significant transformation in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, driven by a commitment to advancing healthcare and innovation. This evolution aims to better serve patients, collaborate with healthcare stakeholders, and contribute to the Saudi Vision 2030. About the Role: Medical Science Liaison Biologics AstraZeneca is seeking a Medical Science Liaison (MSL) for Biologics in Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role requires extensive scientific expertise in the therapeutic area to engage in scientific discussions and presentations with Key External Experts (KEEs) regarding disease areas and clinical data in a non-promotional context. The MSL is responsible for generating actionable insights from KEEs and communicating these to the brand team to inform Medical and Brand strategy. This position involves working with external stakeholders to foster scientific and strategic partnerships within major hospitals, institutions, and non-traditional stakeholders such as policy makers and payer groups. Key Responsibilities Identify, prioritize, and expand KEE networks to include non-traditional stakeholders based on scientific/clinical expertise and influence on practice change. Engage in scientific discussions and medical advancements in a balanced, objective, and accurate manner. Provide insights into the local medical community, clinical practice trends, HCP insights, and gaps in scientific knowledge. Foster scientific partnerships with KEEs to advance disease understanding and achieve evidence-based changes in medical practice. Interact with the medical community on various medical projects, including clinical trials, Non-Interventional Studies, and Investigator Sponsored Studies (ISSs). Identify and train speakers for local events and provide recommendations for advisory board participants. Present scientific data to healthcare professionals (HCPs) in both group and one-on-one settings. Collect and share actionable insights with internal stakeholders to enhance the value and appropriate use of AstraZeneca products. Organize and facilitate scientific events for healthcare institutions and their multidisciplinary teams related to the therapeutic area. Act as a scientific expert for internal stakeholders, demonstrating knowledge of AstraZeneca products, emerging therapies, and clinical trials. Provide scientific support at AstraZeneca-sponsored educational events and plan regional medical activities during product launch processes. Respond to unsolicited requests for information about unapproved AstraZeneca products or uses, presenting information objectively and factually. Required Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 1 year of experience in a Medical Affairs role within the pharmaceutical industry in Saudi Arabia. Experience in the Respiratory/Biologics therapy area. Familiarity with the healthcare environment, including opinion leaders, the medical community, and related dynamics in Saudi Arabia. Demonstrated track record of driving clinical practice shaping and impactful stakeholder mobilization. Desirable Skills and Attributes Demonstrated business acumen and a track record of end-to-end project management. Full understanding of the medical role in driving innovative value strategies and supporting patient access to evidence-based treatment. Established track record of basic or clinical research. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. AstraZeneca is committed to building an inclusive and diverse team and considers applications from all qualified candidates.

377a9a0f4571c69a.description: About the Role We are seeking an experienced and analytical Governance and Compliance Consultant to join our team. Manage the end-to-end Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) process, ensuring timely and accurate submission of insurance claims to all insurance providers. Validate insurance claims by reviewing billing accuracy, medical coding, documentation, and compliance with payer requirements to minimize claim denials. Monitor claim rejections, collections, and reimbursement performance, analyze denial trends, implement corrective actions, and improve cash flow and revenue recovery. Lead reconciliation meetings with healthcare operators and insurance companies to resolve payment discrepancies, outstanding claims, billing issues, and account reconciliations. Develop and present financial and revenue cycle KPIs to senior leadership, identifying financial risks, revenue optimization opportunities, and process improvement initiatives. Ensure financial compliance and stakeholder collaboration by supporting internal and external audits, maintaining compliance with financial policies and healthcare regulations, and serving as the primary liaison between KAUST Health, Finance, healthcare operators, and insurance companies. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline (Finance or Accounting preferred). Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or Healthcare Management is preferred. Professional certification such as CPA, CMA, ACCA, or equivalent is considered an added advantage. Minimum of 6 years of professional experience, including at least 3 years in a leadership or specialist role in finance, healthcare finance, or revenue cycle management.
